Intro.SourceString: 部署喵喵卫士，自动攻击一定范围内的敌人，并使其减速
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy Pawtectors to automatically attack and slow nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 被敌人枪械命中时，可将其短暂透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Briefly reveal enemies when hit by their direct weapon fire.

Intro.SourceString: 部署火力炮艇，自动攻击一定范围内的敌人
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a turret to auto-attack nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 进入火力强劲的架枪状态，该状态下连续射击会使枪管过热
Intro.LocalizedString: Enter Deployment Mode; continuous shooting can cause Overheat.

Intro.SourceString: 进入架枪或开镜状态时召唤正面护盾，架枪模式下会获得额外的护盾最大值
Intro.LocalizedString: Generate a frontal shield when entering Deployment or ADS, with extra shield capacity in Deployment Mode.

Intro.SourceString: 最多可发射六发枚榴弹炮，爆炸后生成火海，对范围内的所有敌人造成持续伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire up to 6 grenades, creating a sea of flames that deals ongoing damage to all enemies in range.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出脉冲刀制造磁场区域，范围内的敌方会被透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Pulse Blade to create a field that reveals enemies in the area.

Intro.SourceString: 主武器命中敌方时，短暂透视其位置给自己
Intro.LocalizedString: When your Primary Weapon hits an enemy, their location is briefly revealed.

Intro.SourceString: 在前方生成矩形磁场，进入磁场隐身并提升移速，主动攻击或进行交互时会短暂显形
Intro.LocalizedString: Create a Stealth Zone ahead, becoming invisible and boosting Movement Speed upon entering. Attacking or interacting briefly reveals your position.

Intro.SourceString: 发射电球，飞行至最大距离或碰到敌人时会引爆，吸取范围内的敌方护甲并使其减速。电球可提前手动引爆
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire an Electric Orb that detonates on contact or at max range, draining Armor and slowing enemies in range. Can manually detonate early.

Intro.SourceString: 使用枪械或技能对敌方护甲造成伤害时，可回复自己的护甲。枪械会对敌方护甲造成额外伤害。
Intro.LocalizedString: Weapons deal extra DMG to enemy Armor. Damaging enemy Armor regenerates your own.

Intro.SourceString: 获得临时护甲并使射击附加减速效果。该技能持续期间使用枪械或技能对敌方护甲造成伤害时，会回复临时护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Gain Temporary Armor and apply a slow effect with shots. Damage enemy Armor with weapons or skills to extend the skill duration and replenish temporary Armor.

Intro.SourceString: 发射颜料，对范围内的敌人施加减速、弦化禁止和暴露脚印的效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire paint to String-Block, slow, and reveal footprints of enemies in range.

Intro.SourceString: 主武器命中敌人时，会使其减速并暴露脚印
Intro.LocalizedString: Primary Weapon hits slow enemies and reveal their tracks.

Intro.SourceString: 发射巨大泡泡，范围内的敌人会被禁止弦化并暴露脚印，泡泡爆炸时会对范围内的敌人额外施加减速和易伤效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire a giant bubble that String-Blocks and reveals tracks of enemies inside. When it bursts, it slows and makes enemies in the area vulnerable.

Intro.SourceString: 布置守望之眼，在范围内时提升自己的射速和人机工效并回复护甲。守望之眼相连时，强化增益效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a Guardian Eye to boost Rate of Fire, Weapon Usability, and regenerate Armor when in range. Connect Guardian Eyes to enhance these bonuses.

Intro.SourceString: 开镜状态会积蓄能量，蓄满后射击命中敌人时，使其武器丢失精准度
Intro.LocalizedString: Charge energy in ADS mode. When fully charged, your shots hitting enemies will cause their weapons to lose accuracy.

Intro.SourceString: 部署脉冲装置周期性发射脉冲波，被脉冲波命中的敌人将被透视并进入沉默状态
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a Pulse Generator that emits periodic waves. Struck enemies are revealed and silenced.

Intro.SourceString: 为自己或队友生成治疗无人机，可回复护甲，并给无人机周围所有友方目标回复生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a Drone on yourself or a teammate to restore Armor and heal all nearby allies.

Intro.SourceString: 自己在未受击时缓慢恢复生命值；当救援队友时，会放出援护无人机自动扶起队友
Intro.LocalizedString: Slowly regenerate HP when not taking DMG. When assisting an ally, deploy a support drone to automatically rescue them.

Intro.SourceString: 选择一名队友，若该队友已阵亡，则将其复活在自己附近，若该队友存活，则在短时间内提高目标队友的射速、移速、人机工效，并且降低其受到的伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Select a teammate: revive them nearby if downed. If alive, temporarily increase their Rate of Fire, Movement Speed, and Weapon Usability, while decreasing DMG received.

Intro.SourceString: 探测周围敌人，满血敌人被短暂透视，非满血敌人则被持续透视，仅自己可见。感应到敌人时提升移速，且对被透视敌人造成额外伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Detect nearby enemies; full HP targets appear briefly, while those with less HP remain visible longer, all only visible to you. Detecting them boosts your Movement Speed and increases DMG to those enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 参与击败时，阵亡的敌人原地掉落能量晶体。靠近可吸收能量晶体，回复自身生命值。首次吸收时会增加自身生命值上限
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies killed or assisted by you drop Energy Crystals. Get close to absorb it and restore your HP. The first absorption increases your max HP.

Intro.SourceString: 大幅度提升射速和人机工效，并高亮主动技能视野内的敌人。吸收能量晶体将延长该效果的持续时间
Intro.LocalizedString: Greatly boost your Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability, highlighting enemies within your Active Skill's vision. Absorbing Energy Crystals extends this effect's duration.

Intro.SourceString: 选择一名队友投掷流星弦能，增加临时护甲，之后流星弦能再返回自己身上，也增加临时护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Grant Temporary Armor to a chosen teammate, then receive Temporary Armor yourself.

Intro.SourceString: 持续为自身及周围友军缓慢恢复护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Continuously restore Armor for yourself and nearby allies.

Intro.SourceString: 选择一名队友，为该队友和自己提供临时护甲并开始蓄能，蓄能完毕后将传送到该队友身边
Intro.LocalizedString: Select a teammate to give both of you Temporary Armor and start charging. Teleport to them when fully charged.

Intro.SourceString: 打出一颗弦能球体，于落点处创造一片黄沙领域，降低敌方角色移速和人机工效一段时间并暂时削减其生命值。
Intro.LocalizedString: Launch an Energy Orb to create a Sandstorm at the point of impact, temporarily reducing enemy Movement Speed, Weapon Usability, and HP.

Intro.SourceString: 滞空下进入瞄准或开火状态时，自己下落的速度会被降低
Intro.LocalizedString: While airborne, aiming or firing slows your descent.

Intro.SourceString: 投掷出能制造巨大沙暴领域的金字塔，领域可遮蔽视野，并暂时削减敌人生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a Haboob to obscure vision and temporarily drain enemy HP.

Intro.SourceString: 进入弦化状态向前冲刺，并为主武器补充子弹。使用主武器命中敌人时，会返还部分冷却时间
Intro.LocalizedString: Stringify to Dash forward, reloading your Primary Weapon. Hitting enemies returns some CD time.

Intro.SourceString: 主武器命中敌人造成至少50点伤害时，可使其禁止弦化
Intro.LocalizedString: Primary Weapon string-blocks enemies upon dealing at least 50 DMG in a single shot.

Intro.SourceString: 原地放置重生信标，阵亡或倒地时可立即在信标处重生。再次按下大招按钮可主动返回信标
Intro.LocalizedString: Place a Beacon to Respawn instantly if downed or killed. Press the skill key again to return to the Beacon.

Intro.SourceString: 释放纵向或横向的弦能光幕，光幕会遮蔽视野
Intro.LocalizedString: Cast a vertical or horizontal Light Screen to obscure vision.

Intro.SourceString: 开镜状态下，每隔一段时间可扫描敌方单位使其透视，仅自己可见
Intro.LocalizedString: In ADS mode, periodically scan enemies, revealing them briefly only to you.

Intro.SourceString: 立即刷新主动技能，在持续时间内增强光幕，格挡所有敌人的子弹
Intro.LocalizedString: Instantly refresh Active Skill, enhancing the Light Screen to block all enemy bullets.

Intro.SourceString: 召出战术熊冲撞，撞到障碍物会留下冰面，范围内的敌人受到打滑和易伤的效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon Fay to charge, leaving ice when hitting obstacles. Enemies in range slip and become more vulnerable.

Intro.SourceString: 站立不动一段时间会进入迷彩隐身状态，敌人靠近时才会慢慢显形
Intro.LocalizedString: Stand still to enter camo stealth, becoming visible only as enemies get closer.

Intro.SourceString: 召唤出巨大冰霜熊展开极寒领域，范围内的敌人会被打滑、易伤、降低射速和人机工效
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a Frost Bear to create Polar Zones, causing enemies to Slip, become Vulnerable, and lowering their Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability.

Intro.SourceString: 发射声呐片生成探测区域，范围内的敌人会被透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire a Sonar Disk to reveal enemies in the area.

Intro.SourceString: 主武器的子弹落点可产生音波区，范围内的敌人会被透视给自己
Intro.LocalizedString: Shots from the primary weapon create a Sonar Zone, revealing enemies within to you.

Intro.SourceString: 展开舞台播放音乐，范围内的敌人会被减速、丢失准星、晕眩和降低射速
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a holographic figure to play music, slowing, stunning, and disorienting enemies, reducing their Rate of Fire.

Intro.SourceString: 幻蝶跟随期间受到攻击损失生命值时进入短暂无敌并原地生成一个限制敌方视野的致幻球。致幻球可被击碎
Intro.LocalizedString: While butterflies follow you, taking HP DMG briefly makes you invincible and summons a Phantom Orb at your location. The orb limits enemy vision and can be destroyed.

Intro.SourceString: 累计受到少量伤害时会减少主动技能的冷却时间；受到大量伤害时会获得临时绝招点数
Intro.LocalizedString: Taking minor DMG reduces your Active Skill CD. Taking major DMG grants temporary Ultimate Points, valid for the current round.

Intro.SourceString: 以自身为中心释放致幻领域，受到领域内的敌方造成的致命伤害时，短暂无敌且重塑身体。领域外敌方仅在被攻击时可视芙拉薇娅
Intro.LocalizedString: Create a Phantom Zone around you. Within it, fatal enemy attacks trigger a brief invincibility state. Enemies outside can only see you when attacked.

Intro.SourceString: 生成火焰牢狱，当艾卡与敌人同时处于牢狱内时，主武器攻击附加额外火焰伤害；敌人穿越牢壁时受到火焰伤害，满热伤害提升，弦化目标易伤；牢狱内无敌人则立即消散
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a Flame Cage. While you and enemies are inside, your Primary Weapon inflicts extra Burn DMG. Enemies crossing the cage walls take Burn DMG, with extra DMG when at full Heat and for Stringified enemies. The cage disperses if empty.

Intro.SourceString: 每次射击命中敌方目标积攒热量。满热时，弦化伤害增加；释放技能自动消耗全部热量强化效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Each shot on an enemy accumulates Heat. At Max Heat, DMG against stringified enemies increases. Skills automatically consume Heat for enhanced effects.

Intro.SourceString: 释放烈焰风暴吹飞敌人并造成火焰伤害。满热下风暴更大，伤害更高，且敌人高亮
Intro.LocalizedString: Release a Firestorm to force glide enemies and deal Burn DMG. At max Heat, the storm is larger, deals more DMG, and highlights enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 扔出一张卡牌，碰到地面、墙面时会生成分身，按下交互键可以传送到分身位置
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a card to create a decoy on impact. Press the interact key to teleport to the decoy.

Intro.SourceString: 脱离墙面时在贴墙位置留下一个分身，分身受伤时该效果进入冷却。所有分身在生成时都会短暂透视范围内的敌人，攻击分身的敌人也会暴露位置
Intro.LocalizedString: Leave a decoy when unsticking from a wall. If the decoy is damaged, the effect goes on CD. All decoys briefly reveal nearby enemies upon creation, and attacking the decoy exposes the attackers' positions.

Intro.SourceString: 朝前方甩出卡牌，生成三个不同方位的可传送分身，同时刷新主动技能
Intro.LocalizedString: Toss cards forward to create three teleportation decoys in different positions and refresh the Active Skill.

Intro.SourceString: 释放香水生成香氛领域，友方在领域内获得攻速或移速增益，效果随时间衰减至消失
Intro.LocalizedString: Release perfume to create an aroma field, boosting allies' Rate of Fire or Movement Speed. The effect fades over time.

Intro.SourceString: 释放淡雅恢复香氛，持续为自身及周围友军缓慢恢复生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Release a healing aroma to slowly restore HP to yourself and nearby teammates.

Intro.SourceString: 以自己为中心制造强烈香氛区域，区域内友军会获得射速提升、移速提升和生命值恢复，该生命值恢复不会被伤害中断。释放期间珐格兰丝无法使用武器，但会获得大幅减伤
Intro.LocalizedString: Create a potent aroma field, boosting allies' Rate of Fire, Movement Speed, and HP regeneration without interruption. Can't use weapons during release but gains significant DMG reduction.

Intro.SourceString: 布置一个蜗牛装置，激活后临时腐蚀附近敌方角色的护甲上限。蜗牛装置最多同时存在3个
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a snail device that temporarily erodes nearby enemies' Max Armor on activation. Up to 3 devices can exist at once.

Intro.SourceString: 使用主武器对敌方角色的生命值造成一定量伤害后，会对目标及附近的敌方角色造成伤害并临时腐蚀其护甲上限
Intro.LocalizedString: After dealing sufficient HP DMG with your Primary Weapon, inflict extra DMG on the target and nearby enemies, temporarily lowering their Max Armor.

Intro.SourceString: 召唤大范围的毒雾向前方缓慢推进，临时腐蚀范围内敌方角色的护甲上限
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a sweeping mist that advances forward, temporarily reducing the Max Armor of enemies in its path.

Intro.SourceString: 在指定区域生成两种角度的方块掩体，生成消耗技能点数及弦能条。方块最多同时存在16个
Intro.LocalizedString: Generate square blocks with two-angle options in designated areas. Generating blocks consumes skill points and energy. Up to 16 blocks can exist at once.

Intro.SourceString: 当弦能高于50%时，提高自身一定移动速度；低于50%时，逐渐恢复自身护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: When energy is above 50%, increase Movement Speed; if below 50%, gradually restore Armor.

Intro.SourceString: 充满弦能条并恢复一定量的主动技能层数，技能持续期间场上存在方块永久变透明，透明方块将不再阻挡通路与友方子弹
Intro.LocalizedString: Fill the energy bar and restore some Active Skill charges. During the skill duration, existing blocks become permanently transparent, no longer blocking paths or ally bullets.

Intro.SourceString: 射出一发可附着在建筑表面的爆炸箭，爆炸箭可以被提前引爆，或在到达最大存在时间后自行爆炸
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire an explosive arrow that sticks to surfaces, which can be detonated early or auto-detonates when its duration ends.

Intro.SourceString: 持续恢复专注度，进行攻击后会短暂减缓恢复速度;满专注值时，造成伤害后会消耗专注值并在一段时间内强化自身输出
Intro.LocalizedString: Steadily regain Focus, with recovery slowing briefly after attacks. When full, Focus is consumed to boost DMG briefly.

Intro.SourceString: 短暂透视队友附近的敌人，并且在蓄力后向目标方向发射可以穿透墙体的爆炸箭。箭矢在到达最大飞行距离或命中敌人后爆炸
Intro.LocalizedString: Temporarily reveal enemies near allies and fire a charged wall-piercing explosive arrow at the target. The arrow explodes upon reaching max range or hitting an enemy.

Intro.SourceString: 向前施放鬼手，命中最近一名非倒地的敌方角色，使其灵魂出窍和减速。玛拉对灵魂球造成伤害时，给予敌人忽视护甲的生命值伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Cast a phantom hand to target the nearest standing enemy, extracting a Soul Orb and slowing them. Only you can hit the Soul Orb, dealing armor-ignoring HP DMG to the enemy.

Intro.SourceString: 对非满血敌方造成伤害时附带额外忽视护甲的生命值伤害，且以一定比率恢复自身生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Deal DMG to non-full-HP enemies to inflict extra armor-ignoring HP DMG and restore your own HP.

Intro.SourceString: 标记范围内最近敌方目标，使其沉默并持续透视给自己。若击杀该目标，印记将扩散至附近最近未倒地敌人并重置持续时间
Intro.LocalizedString: Mark the nearest enemy, silencing them and revealing their location to you. If you knock down or kill the target, the mark transfers to the nearest standing enemy within range and resets its duration.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能命中透视
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skill wall hacking on hit

Intro.SourceString: 敌方单位被喵喵卫士攻击时会被持续透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Pawtectors' attacks make enemies continuously visible.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 召唤物被毁提供护甲
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Summons provide armor upon destruction

Intro.SourceString: 当喵喵卫士在自己周围45米内阵亡时，自身获得临时护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Gain Temporary Armor when a Pawtector is destroyed within 45m.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 召唤物附近获得强化
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Summons enhance nearby units

Intro.SourceString: 当自己在喵喵卫士15米范围内时，增加自身射速和人机工效
Intro.LocalizedString: Increase your Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability when within 15m of a Pawtector.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 架枪状态下可以水平移动
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: While in deployment, enables horizontal movement.

Intro.SourceString: 架设状态下可以进行左右移动
Intro.LocalizedString: Allows lateral movement in Deployment Mode.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 架枪状态下可以设置会自动攻击的机枪
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: While in deployment, enables deployment of a machine gun that automatically attacks enemies

Intro.SourceString: 架枪状态下能够部署自动机枪。再按下主动技能按钮，可收回机枪
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy an Autoturret in Deployment Mode by holding the Active Skill button. Press again to retrieve it.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主武器无需换弹，但会过热
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Primary weapon doesn't need reloading, but it can overheat.

Intro.SourceString: 连续射击时射速逐渐提升，且主武器不再需要换弹，但射击会使枪管受热
Intro.LocalizedString: Rate of Fire gradually increases with continuous shooting. Primary Weapon no longer needs to Reload, but continuous shooting can cause Overheat.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 造成伤害可以透视给我方
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Dealing damage enables wall hacking for allies

Intro.SourceString: 所有受到自己伤害的敌方都会被透视
Intro.LocalizedString: All damaged enemies are revealed to the team.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 被主动技能笼罩的敌人脱离时会减速
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enemies are slowed as they escape active skills' area of effect

Intro.SourceString: 脉冲刀扫描到敌人时生成一段电磁锁链并施加减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Pulse Blade generates a chain and applies a slow effect when it scans enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能未扫到敌人时不再会提前消失
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills no longer disappear if no enemies are hit

Intro.SourceString: 脉冲刀施加的透视时间缩短，完成扫描后不会立刻消失，有敌人处于扫描范围内时将会再次进行扫描
Intro.LocalizedString: Pulse Blade's reveal time is shortened, but it won't deactivate immediately after a scan. It rescans if enemies are within range.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 失去护甲时会增加移速
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Gain movement speed when losing armor

Intro.SourceString: 完全失去护甲时，短暂提升移速。再次触发该效果可刷新持续时间
Intro.LocalizedString: Losing all Armor briefly boosts Movement Speed. Re-triggering refreshes the duration.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能造成伤害会获得临时护甲
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Dealing damage with active skills grants temporary armor

Intro.SourceString: 破甲电球首段爆炸对敌人造成伤害时，给自己增加临时护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Initial Sunder Blast hits grant Temporary Armor.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 在主动技能范围内可以恢复护甲
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Restore armor while in the area of effect of active skills

Intro.SourceString: 自己处于电磁场范围内可以恢复护甲，该效果不会被伤害中断
Intro.LocalizedString: Regenerate Armor within Electro Field. Taking DMG does not interrupt this effect.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 在颜料内移动可以隐身并回血
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Moving on paints grants invisibility and healing

Intro.SourceString: 己方角色在颜料区域内贴墙时，会潜入颜料并缓慢回复生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Teammates wall-sticking in painted areas will conceal themselves and slowly heal.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能在飞行时会自动分裂更多颜料
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: While in flight, active skills split automatically into more paint

Intro.SourceString: 发射的颜料在飞行时，会向下掉落多道颜料线，额外生成颜料区域
Intro.LocalizedString: Fires paint that forms a trailing line, creating additional paint zones.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 颜料区域会生成一个遮挡视野的减益泡泡
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Paint areas generate a debuff bubble that blocks vision

Intro.SourceString: 颜料区域内会生成一个泡泡，可遮挡视野，敌人触碰后会立即爆炸并被施加颜料减益效果
Intro.LocalizedString: A view-blocking bubble forms over the paint zone, exploding upon contact and applying a paint debuff to enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 在线圈范围内可以免疫一次致命伤害
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Gains immunity to one stance of lethal damage within the circle

Intro.SourceString: 在线圈内自己可免疫一次致命伤害，并恢复一定量的生命与护甲值
Intro.LocalizedString: Inside the device range, survive one fatal hit and recover some HP and armor.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 可以透视进入线圈范围内的敌人
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enables wall hackings against enemies within the circle

Intro.SourceString: 进入信线圈范围的敌方单位会被持续透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies entering the device's range are continuously revealed.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 可以在线圈之间传送
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enables teleportation within the circle

Intro.SourceString: 可从一个线圈传送至另一个线圈
Intro.LocalizedString: You can teleport between devices.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能会立刻回复大量生命值
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills heal a large amount of HP

Intro.SourceString: 治疗无人机开始治疗友方单位时，会先瞬间恢复大量生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: When the Drone begins healing an ally, it instantly restores a large amount of HP.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能护甲回复扩大到范围内所有友方
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active Skill: Extends armor recovery to all allies within range

Intro.SourceString: 无人机能够为周围所有友方恢复护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: The Drone restores Armor to all nearby allies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能可以为治疗目标抵挡伤害
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills block damage for healing targets

Intro.SourceString: 当敌人射击治疗目标时会优先由无人机承受伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: The Drone shields its healing target by absorbing incoming DMG.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 被动技能生效范围变为无限距离
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Passive skills have an infinite range

Intro.SourceString: 晶体吸收的范围扩大至全图
Intro.LocalizedString: Crystal absorption range extends to the entire map.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 倒地后会在短暂时间内自动站起
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Auto-recover shortly after being knocked down.

Intro.SourceString: 倒地后会在短暂时间内自动站起
Intro.LocalizedString: Auto-recover shortly after being knocked down.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能释放时将减速范围内敌人
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills slow enemies in range

Intro.SourceString: 释放主动技能的瞬间，范围内的敌人会被短暂减速
Intro.LocalizedString: Active skill briefly slows enemies in range.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能将施加护甲回复状态
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills apply armor regen

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能附加护甲回复效果，持续一段时间，该效果不会被伤害中断
Intro.LocalizedString: Active Skill gains Temporary Armor regeneration, immune to DMG interruptions.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能施加后的我方失去护甲时会致盲敌人
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: After applying active skills, enemies blind enemies when losing armor

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能附带额外效果：当护甲被破坏时，星光会从头顶飞出并致盲敌人
Intro.LocalizedString: When the Armor from the Active Skill is breached, it releases starlight that blinds enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能提供的护甲量更多
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills grant more armor

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能命中时将立即回复一定的护甲值
Intro.LocalizedString: Active Skill instantly restores some Armor.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 我方在主动技能范围内飘飞将被向上吹
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Allies are blown upward when gliding in the area of effect of active skills

Intro.SourceString: 黄沙领域内的友方角色处于飘飞状态时将会被向上吹起。
Intro.LocalizedString: Allies gliding within the sandstorm are lifted upward by a powerful gust.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能会反弹并额外生成一个领域
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills ricochet and generate an additional field

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能可进行一次额外的反弹并生成至多2个黄沙领域。
Intro.LocalizedString: Active Skill can now ricochet, creating up to 2 Sandstorms.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能领域内的敌人视野受限
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enemies within the Sandstorm have their field of view greatly reduced.

Intro.SourceString: 黄沙领域内的敌人视野范围会受到极大限制。
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies within the Sandstorm have their field of view greatly reduced.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 被动技能的视野遮罩效果更强
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enhances passive skills' field of view making effects

Intro.SourceString: 被动触发时，对敌人的视野遮罩效果将更加强烈且会造成减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: The passive skill now triggers a strong visual obstruction and slows enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 会对在主动技能落点附近的敌人视野遮罩
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Landing active skills masks nearby enemies' vision

Intro.SourceString: 使用主动技能会在落点处溅起颜料，对周围敌人造成短暂的视野遮蔽效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Using the Active Skill splashes paint at the landing spot, briefly obscuring nearby enemies' vision.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能使用时会在原地留下假身并短暂隐身
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills leave behind a false avatar and activate stealth briefly

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能使用期间会隐身，并在起点留下假身
Intro.LocalizedString: During the Active Skill, enter Stealth and leave a Decoy at the starting point.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 敌人穿越令的光幕会被透视
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enables wall hacking against enemies crossing Reiichi's Sacred Light

Intro.SourceString: 敌人穿越光幕时会被短暂透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies crossing the Light Screen are temporarily exposed.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 我方/敌方穿越光幕会临时获得/减少护甲
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Allies gain armor crossing Sacred Light, while enemies lose armor

Intro.SourceString: 敌人穿越光幕时会被暂时削减护甲上限。友方穿越光幕时会获得临时护甲，在短时间内反复经过只会获得一次
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies crossing the Light Screen temporarily lose Max Armor. Allies crossing gain Temporary Armor, triggering once in a short period.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 我方在光幕附近可以看到光幕后的视野
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Allies see through Sacred Light while near it

Intro.SourceString: 友方靠近光幕时，光幕会变成半透明状态，敌方则始终无法看透光幕
Intro.LocalizedString: The Light Screen turns semi-transparent for nearby allies while remaining opaque to enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 熊在消失时会自爆并留下冰面
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: The bear self-destructs as it disappears, leaving behind ice

Intro.SourceString: 战术熊消失时会自爆并留下冰面，爆炸中心的敌人会受到短暂的强力减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Fay explodes upon disappearing, slowing nearby enemies and leaving an icy surface.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 熊的攻击方式变为丢雪球
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: The bear now attacks by throwing snowballs

Intro.SourceString: 战术熊的攻击方式变为投掷雪球，雪球砸中时会生成冰面，被砸中的敌人也会受到伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Fay now throws snowballs that create ice and damage enemies on impact.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 熊会自动攻击附近的敌人
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Fay automatically attacks nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 当处于非操控状态时的战术熊察觉到范围内有敌方时，原地生成冰面
Intro.LocalizedString: When uncontrolled, Fay detects enemies in range and forms ice on the spot.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主武器会在落点造成溅射伤害
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Primary weapons deal splash damage

Intro.SourceString: 主武器射击产生的音波区内的敌人受到额外伤害，并被透视
Intro.LocalizedString: Primary weapon shots create a Sonar Zone, dealing extra DMG and revealing enemies.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 敌人在主动技能范围内会在一段延迟后被晕眩
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enemies within the area of effect of active skills are stunned after a delay

Intro.SourceString: 被声呐片探测到的敌人在一定时间内没有脱离探测范围，则会被晕眩并降低射速
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies detected by the Sonar Disk get stunned and have reduced Rate of Fire if they remain in range.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 我方在主动技能范围内会被强化
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Allies are enhanced while in the area of effect of active skills

Intro.SourceString: 在声呐片探测范围内的友方将提升移速，人机工效，射速
Intro.LocalizedString: Allies within the Sonar Disk's range gain increased Movement Speed, Weapon Usability, and Rate of Fire.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 使用主动技能后会回血
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Recover HP after casting active skills

Intro.SourceString: 放出致幻球后，自身在一段时间内持续回复生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: After summoning a Phantom Orb, you regenerate HP over time.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 使用主动技能将立刻生成致幻球
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Generate a Phantom Orb after casting active skills

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能的效果改为召唤幻蝶后立即进入短时间的无敌隐身状态，并留下致幻球
Intro.LocalizedString: Modifies the active skill to immediately grant stealth and invincibility for a short period, summoning a Phantom Orb at your location.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 致幻球承受的伤害会转化为临时护甲
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Phantom Orbs convert damage taken into temporary armor

Intro.SourceString: 致幻球持续时间耗尽或被击破后，芙拉薇娅会获得临时护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Gain Temporary Armor after the Phantom Orb's duration expires or it's destroyed.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 敌人在主动技能范围内弦化会受伤
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enemies stringified within the Flame Cage take DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 敌人在主动技能范围内弦化时，会受到火焰烧伤
Intro.LocalizedString: Enemies stringified within the Flame Cage take Burn DMG.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能的半径会逐渐缩小
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skills' radius gradually decreases

Intro.SourceString: 开启主动技能后，炼狱牢笼半径持续收缩至最小半径
Intro.LocalizedString: After casting the Active Skill, the cage radius shrinks until it reaches the minimum size.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 消耗热量时将会回血
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Recover HP when consuming heat

Intro.SourceString: 热量减少时以一定比例转化为生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: As Heat decreases, it converts to a proportion of HP recovery.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 传送完成后强化自身
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Receives buff after teleporting.

Intro.SourceString: 传送到目的地时获得临时护甲并短暂提升人机工效
Intro.LocalizedString: Gain Temporary Armor and briefly boost Weapon Usability upon teleporting.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 传送完成后会隐身
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Enables stealth after teleporting.

Intro.SourceString: 传送触发隐身3秒，期间移速增加且收起武器
Intro.LocalizedString: Teleport to trigger 3 seconds of stealth, increasing Movement Speed and holstering your weapon.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 传送完成后在原位遗留假身
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Leaves a decoy at the original location after teleporting.

Intro.SourceString: 传送成功后，在传送前所处的位置留下一个3D假身
Intro.LocalizedString: Leave a decoy at your original location after teleporting.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能将施加生命回复状态
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skill grants healing

Intro.SourceString: 在释放主动技能的瞬间，会使当时处在范围内的队友获得缓慢减弱的回复效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Activating the skill instantly gives nearby allies a fading HP regeneration buff.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能效果更强但仅对范围内我方生效
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Active skill effects are stronger but only affect allies within range.

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能释放瞬间处在范围内的友军同时获得移速和射速加成，但持续时间减少
Intro.LocalizedString: Activating the skill grants nearby allies a Movement Speed and Rate of Fire bonus, but with reduced duration.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能结束后会依旧以更弱效果常驻
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: After the active skill ends, a weaker effect remains active

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能效果变为持续存在，会在逐步减弱后维持该水平。切换香水种类后会更换持续的效果
Intro.LocalizedString: The Active Skill effect now persists at a lower level after weakening. Switching perfume type changes the ongoing effect.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 被动激活后原地残留毒雾
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Yugiri's passive skill leaves behind a toxic mist.

Intro.SourceString: 当敌方角色体内的腐蚀性毒素被引爆后，会在原地形成残留一段时间的腐蚀性毒雾
Intro.LocalizedString: When an enemy's corrosive toxins erupt, a lingering mist forms and persists at the spot for a short duration.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能释放后会扩大范围
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Yugiri's spherical mist gradually expands after activation.

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能开启后，毒雾半径会在一定时间内逐渐扩大
Intro.LocalizedString: Upon activation, the spherical mist gradually expands over time.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 主动技能的毒雾会遮蔽视野
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Yugiri's spherical mist can block enemies' field of view.

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能变为能够遮蔽视野的不透明毒雾。自身在毒雾范围内时会持续恢复护甲，该效果不会被伤害中断
Intro.LocalizedString: The mist turns opaque, blocking vision. Within the mist, you continuously restore Armor without interruption.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 方块可提供护甲恢复增益
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Blocks grant an armor regeneration boost.

Intro.SourceString: 友方角色靠近方块时会缓慢恢复护甲
Intro.LocalizedString: Allies near blocks slowly regenerate Armor.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 方块相连整体共享生命值
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Connected blocks are treated as a single unit with shared HP.

Intro.SourceString: 当多个方块相连时，视为一个整体，共享生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Connected blocks are treated as a single unit with shared HP.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 方块可以切换从天而降的释放方式造成击飞
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Blocks can be dropped from above, knocking enemies airborne.

Intro.SourceString: 方块被击碎后对周围敌人造成爆炸伤害及击飞效果，伤害同样作用在其他方块上
Intro.LocalizedString: When blocks are destroyed, they explode, damaging and briefly knocking nearby enemies airborne. This DMG also affects other blocks.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 参与击杀或者处于灵魂出窍状态的敌方角色倒地时都会获得一层灵魂，灵魂可以强化自己
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Mara gains a soul stack that boosts her stats when she takes down an enemy or when an enemy with a Soul Orb falls.

Intro.SourceString: 参与击倒或击杀敌人时可获得一层魂魄；魂魄层数在当局使用玛拉期间持续叠加，每层提升主武器射速和人机工效，存在上限。死亡时会损失部分层数
Intro.LocalizedString: Gain a soul stack when you knock down or kill an enemy. Stacks persist while using Mara, boosting Primary Weapon Rate of Fire and Weapon Usability. Stacks are capped. Dying reduces your stacks.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 灵魂球不再跟随，敌方超弦体会被眩晕，逃脱则减速
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Soul orbs no longer follow targets. Enemies caught by an orb are stunned, and if they manage to escape the orb, they will be slowed.

Intro.SourceString: 灵魂球不再跟随敌方角色，也不会附加减速，敌人处于灵魂球一定范围内会被眩晕，离开范围灵魂球则摧毁
Intro.LocalizedString: The Soul Orb no longer follows enemies or applies a slow effect. Enemies within its range are stunned but can escape, destroying the orb if they do.

AwakenSketch.SourceString: 传播灵魂球
AwakenSketch.LocalizedString: Soul Orbs can be passed to other enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 当灵魂球因目标死亡或倒地而摧毁时，对范围内离玛拉最近的非倒地敌人进行传导
Intro.LocalizedString: When a Soul Orb is destroyed by taking down an enemy, it transfers to the nearest standing enemy within range.

Intro.SourceString: 千代使用枪械和技能对敌方造成一定量伤害后，会短暂削弱目标的护甲与血量回复效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Deal enough DMG with your primary weapon and skills to temporarily weaken the target's armor and healing effects.

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能爆炸后分裂出多个能量体，并在一段时间后再次爆炸
Intro.LocalizedString: Active Skill explodes, splitting into multiple energy fragments that detonate after a delay.

Intro.SourceString: 主动技能的存在时间大幅延长，可以在准备阶段释放，并且在侦测到周围有敌人时自动引爆
Intro.LocalizedString: Extends Active Skill duration and allows release during the Preparation Phase, auto-detonating when enemies are nearby.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出陷阱喵喵，检测到敌人时会自动激活，对周围敌人造成伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Trap Cat to auto-activate on detection, damaging all nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出榴弹炮台，会自动向视野内敌人发射高爆榴弹
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a Grenade Turret that automatically fires explosive grenades at enemies in sight.

Intro.SourceString: 扔出脉冲刀，造成范围伤害并附加准镜模糊效果，对敌方召唤物造成额外伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Pulse Blade to deal area DMG, blur scopes, and inflict extra DMG on enemy summons.

Intro.SourceString: 发射震撼球，主动引爆或到达最大飞行距离后对范围内敌人造成眩晕、射速降低和准镜模糊效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Fire a Shock Orb that detonates on command or at max range, stunning and reducing Fire Rate for nearby enemies, with a blurred aim effect.

Intro.SourceString: 发射自动向前推进的颜料泡，可阻挡敌方子弹并对范围内敌人施加减速、弦化禁止效果。泡泡在承伤到达极限后破裂
Intro.LocalizedString: Launch forward-moving paint bubbles that block enemy bullets and slow, string-block nearby enemies. Bubbles burst when taking maximum DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出地雷，检测到敌人时会自动激活，对范围内的所有敌人和自己造成持续伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Mine that activates on detecting enemies, dealing DMG over time to all in range, including yourself.

Intro.SourceString: 部署无人机制造区域治疗立场，范围内的友方会持续恢复生命值，该效果不会被伤害打断
Intro.LocalizedString: Deploy a Drone to create a healing zone, continuously restoring HP to allies inside. Healing isn't interrupted by DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 消耗少量的生命值，获得短暂的移速提升效果，移速提升效果结束后会缓慢恢复消耗的生命值
Intro.LocalizedString: Consume a small amount of HP for a brief Movement Speed boost, gradually restoring the lost HP after the boost ends.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出星芒制造护甲恢复区域，范围内的友方会获得临时护甲与持续护甲恢复。该效果不会被伤害打断
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Starflare to create an Armor recovery zone, granting allies Temporary Armor and continuous Armor regeneration inside. This effect isn't interrupted by DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 发射弦能球体，制造一片阻挡视野的环状沙墙
Intro.LocalizedString: Launch an Energy Orb to create a sandstorm that blocks vision.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出颜料瓶，爆炸使周围敌人受到减速、眩晕和射速降低的效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw an Explosive Paint Can that slows, stuns, and reduces the Fire Rate of nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 释放自动向前推进的透明防弹光幕
Intro.LocalizedString: Release a forward-moving transparent, bulletproof Light Screen.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出冰球生成巨大的冰柱，附近的敌人会受到打滑和易伤的效果。冰柱被销毁时会生成冰面，可主动摧毁
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw an ice ball to create a large pillar, causing nearby enemies to Slip and become Vulnerable. When destroyed, the pillar leaves an icy surface that can be manually destroyed.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出音响陷阱，对进入范围的敌方造成短暂减速
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Mini Speaker to briefly slow enemies entering its range.

Intro.SourceString: 原地生成致幻烟雾，敌方角色处于烟雾范围内时受到致幻效果，自身处于烟雾范围内时持续恢复护甲，该恢复效果不会被伤害中断
Intro.LocalizedString: Create hallucinogenic smoke that disorients enemies within. While you remain in the smoke, continuously restore Armor, unaffected by DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 投掷毒液装置至目标区域，对范围内敌人持续造成伤害并附加减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a Corrosive Device to the target area, continuously damaging and slowing enemies inside.

Intro.SourceString: 丢出一枚爆焰火球，对弦化状态的敌人造成额外伤害。消耗100热量所获增益：提升伤害并附带减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw an explosive fireball that deals extra DMG to stringified enemies. Consume 100 heat for a DMG boost and slowing effect.

Intro.SourceString: 释放一个不可传送的卡片分身，该分身被敌人摧毁时对周围所有敌人造成闪光效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Summon a decoy that cannot be teleported to. If destroyed, it blinds all nearby enemies.

Intro.SourceString: 掷出治疗香水，范围内友军获得暂时生命上限提升与持续血量恢复，该效果不会被伤害打断
Intro.LocalizedString: Throw a healing perfume that grants allies in the area a temporary Max HP boost and continuous HP regeneration, unaffected by DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 消耗技能点与弦能条，在指定区域生成防弹玻璃。防弹玻璃最多同时存在3个
Intro.LocalizedString: Use skill points and String Energy to create Bulletproof Glass in a designated area. Up to 3 glass panels can exist at once.

Intro.SourceString: 弦化进入隐身状态，靠近敌人时显形，同时弦化期间移速增加并获得额外的伤害减免
Intro.LocalizedString: Stringify to enter stealth, becoming visible when near enemies. Movement speed increases, and you gain extra DMG reduction during stringification.

Intro.SourceString: 蓄力后向目标方向发射一支狙击箭矢，根据命中部位造成高额伤害并造成迅速衰退的减速效果
Intro.LocalizedString: Charge and fire an arrow at the target, dealing high DMG and a rapidly fading slow effect based on the impact point.

Intro.SourceString: 向准心方向快速释放一个远程飞行物，碰撞到人或障碍物后形成范围爆炸。点按技能按键开始蓄力，爆炸范围和伤害随蓄力时间增加
Intro.LocalizedString: Launch a swift projectile that explodes on impact, affecting a wide area. Hold the skill button to charge, increasing its DMG and blast radius over time.

Intro.SourceString: 开启后的一段时间内，提升攻击速度和伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Temporarily boosts Attack Speed and DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 朝前方进行一次突刺，对攻击路径上敌方造成伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Dash forward, damaging enemies along the path.

Intro.SourceString: 体内晶化能量汇聚，进行一次强化跳跃
Intro.LocalizedString: Harness energy for an enhanced jump.

Intro.SourceString: 释放晶源之力，瞬间恢复自己及范围内队友的生命值和护甲值
Intro.LocalizedString: Unleash Crystalline power to instantly restore HP and Armor to yourself and nearby allies.

Intro.SourceString: 开启护盾期间，所受伤害降低
Intro.LocalizedString: Activate shield to reduce incoming DMG.

Intro.SourceString: 开启后的一段时间内，移动速度加快
Intro.LocalizedString: Boosts movement speed for a limited time.

Intro.SourceString: 汇聚晶源之力后自爆，对周围敌方造成伤害
Intro.LocalizedString: Gather power then self-destruct to deal DMG to nearby enemies.
